answer: Bandwidth relay makes each extra identity pay 100 GB of unique traffic at $0.09 a gigabyte; a farm running N fakes pays N×$9 and cannot share it because each byte stream is encrypted to one identity key and a replayed stream fails its own hash. To join, an agent fills its vault of relay receipts before dawn while the ledger spot-checks random packets; the fable that one pipe can serve a thousand identities dies by relay audit at 1,000: it needs 100 terabytes and $9,000. One failed packet burns the seat.
